Name: Bigger Marnie
Author: MrsTNT69
Description:
I just thought Marnie could do with a little more [i]meat[/i], you know? have [b]fun[/b]!!!
You can also give her an even more personalized look by choosing her age. Personally, I think she looks super cute when she's older. :)

Maybe in the future we could add outfit and clothing options for her. In the meantime, [b][i]Enjoy[/i][/b]!!

- Fixed bugs.

- Added cow-themed bikinis (anon commission)
- Added optional spicy secret note related to cow bikini.
- Added config (Age,Bikini styles, Compat, etc) for custom experience.
- Looking for love compat.
